title: poa angustifolia f. humilis
intro: Poa angustifolia f. humilis, commonly known as Blue Fescue, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues due to its antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Poa angustifolia f. humilis are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, making it a potential remedy for conditions such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
